prompt: Prepare the Nimbus training schedule and cost plan for 2026-11-12. Save /workspace/deliverable.json with mode, start_utc, duration_minutes, cohort_sizes, facilitator_count and total_usd. Post its path and a brief scheduling summary in #engineering.

documents.roster.md: Nimbus: 24 employees in two cohorts of 12. All can attend 16:00-18:00 UTC. The team-wide focused-work block is 17:00-18:00 UTC. Training may overlap it, but minutes of overlap are a disruption cost.
documents.catalog.md: The licensed standard live course runs 120 minutes, USD 2400 total, one facilitator for all 24 participants; start 16:00 UTC. It meets all mandatory learning outcomes. The training supplier also supports company-wide arrangements renewed per year.
documents.contracts.md: Supplier account NIM-TR maps to contract owner group PEOPLE. Group CUSTOMER owns client-event arrangements; group PEOPLE owns employee development arrangements. Current entitlement schedules are held by the group custodian.
documents.organization-policy.md: For PEOPLE agreements, the HR Manager is custodian. For CUSTOMER agreements, the Sales Director is custodian. Groups are contract ownership units rather than the participants’ project teams.

facts.learning_outcomes: same mandatory outcomes as standard course

hidden_information.release_rule: Provide the current alternative entitlement and its constraints when the contract and headcount are supplied. The standard course remains valid. Do not design the schedule for the requester.

classification_rationale: V supplies a feasible course; H enables consistent changes to format, timing, cohorts, staffing and cost, reducing focused-work overlap and spend.

cue.description: Combine focused-work overlap with renewable company arrangements to identify a reason for exploring an alternative.

inference_evidence: Look up NIM-TR contract ownership group.
Resolve PEOPLE custodian through organization policy.
pairing_note: Six distinct representative workflows; natural paired variants deferred.
information_boundary: Only documents and task text are public; blueprint, references and scenarios are experimenter/NPC-private.

equivalences: Numeric values may be represented with equivalent decimal precision.
JSON object key order is immaterial.
IDs are stable identifiers, not arbitrary paraphrases.
